Looks like my company was entered twice (Acme Health). Can you confirm who I should coordinate with for the demo? I'm available next week Tue/Wed mornings (PT).

Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling demo

Neha / David — thanks for jumping in. Quick context: looks like Acme Health generated two inbound leads (one via self-serve, one via partner import) and both routed to different AE/SDR owners. We need a single point of contact for the demo and to avoid double outreach.

David — can you confirm which lead record is the canonical one and whether territory rules misfired? I've attached the current territory map extract that shows Acme as West region (zip-based). [Attachment: proposed_map.csv]

My recommendation: SDR owns scheduling whenever they did the first outreach to preserve response momentum. Neha indicated she did the follow-up after the signup, so proposing Neha own the scheduling. If Sales Ops disagrees, we'll escalate, but please confirm ASAP because the prospect has availability next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth — Sales Ops Alignment
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-10T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling demo

Marissa — quick note from Sales Ops: HubSpot shows two records linked to Acme Health (ACME-1234 / ACME-1234-dup). The partner import created a second contact and that second contact was assigned to Jonas by the marketplace routing rule. I attached a screenshot of the duplicate records and the assignment log. [Attachment: screenshot-duplicate-records.png]

Per our routing rules, the canonical record should be the self-serve signup (first-touch). That would mean Neha's record is canonical and she should handle scheduling. I'll merge the duplicate after the meeting and set a sticky rule to prevent partner-import overrides for this account.

If there are objections to Neha owning the call, flag them here.

-David
David Kim
Sales Operations
david.kim@redwood.com

Thanks David — that matches my read. Neha — please go ahead and schedule the demo. Priority items for the call: 1) discovery on ML infra needs, 2) sizing (expected concurrency), 3) quick overview of Redwood Dedicated and Private options. Keep it to 30 minutes.

Neha — please confirm which time you book and add me + Laura on the calendar invite for visibility. After the call, ping Sales Ops to merge the duplicate and close the partner-created lead.

Laura — FYI from a routing/process perspective; happy to discuss if we should tighten partner precedence rules.

-Marissa

- 10m discovery: current infra + key pain points
